name: adb-pid-of
description: Resolve an Android package name to its current process ID via `adb shell pidof -s <package>`. Returns the PID as a single number, or empty output when the process is not running. Pass the result as the `pid` parameter to android-logcat to scope monitoring to one app. Set ANDROID_SERIAL in the environment to target a specific device when multiple are connected.

subcommand.name: default
subcommand.description: Print the PID for the given Android package, or nothing when the package is not running.
subcommand.install_instructions: Install ADB via Android Studio or: brew install android-platform-tools

custom.usage: Use to get the PID before calling android-logcat with `pid` parameter: adb-pid-of com.example.myapp → pass that PID as `pid` to android-logcat.
custom.note: Set ANDROID_SERIAL=<serial> (from adb-devices) in the environment to target a specific device.
